headline: Fire tablet emulator install diagnostics strengthened

changes.title: Avoid unreliable streamed tablet APK installs
changes.detail: Changed the Google-free AOSP tablet smoke workflow to use bounded non-streaming ADB installation with a second attempt and saved stdout/stderr, after the previous emulator reported a broken pipe before opening the game.

changes.title: Protect the Fire smoke-test failure contract
changes.detail: Extended the optional emulator script checks to require non-streaming installation, a limited retry count, and a definitive failure if both installations fail. No Android application functionality or approved artwork has been changed.
